articles.title: Bijnor: Petrol Pump Owner Sunny Chaudhary Allegedly Assaulted by Kanwar Pilgrims.
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Bijnor (Uttar Pradesh): A petrol pump owner, Sunny Chaudhary, was allegedly assaulted by a group of Kanwar pilgrims (Kanwariyas) on February 10 at the Badhapur Road intersection under Nagina police station limits in Bijnor district.

body.html:
Bijnor (Uttar Pradesh): A petrol pump owner, Sunny Chaudhary, was allegedly assaulted by a group of Kanwar pilgrims (Kanwariyas) on February 10 at the Badhapur Road intersection under Nagina police station limits in Bijnor district.

Incident Details

According to reports, Chaudhary had set up arrangements at his petrol pump to serve Kanwariyas during their pilgrimage. The situation escalated when one of the pilgrims reportedly placed a Kanwar (holy pitcher) on a fuel dispenser and lit incense sticks (agarbatti).

When Chaudhary objected—reportedly citing safety concerns at a fueling station—an argument broke out. The dispute allegedly turned violent, with a group of pilgrims assaulting him.

Videos of the incident circulating on social media show heated exchanges. In one clip, a voice can be heard alleging that “a Muslim person kicked the Kanwar,” while another claims that a “Shivling was kicked.” Reports indicate that during the assault, some attackers allegedly referred to Chaudhary as a Muslim.

Allegations of Police Inaction

Witnesses claim that police personnel were present at the scene but did not intervene to stop the assault. Instead, they reportedly pacified the Kanwariyas and allowed them to continue their journey.

As of February 15, 2026, no formal FIR has been registered in connection with the assault.

Following the viral circulation of the video, the Uttar Pradesh Police issued a clarification stating:

The Kanwar was not damaged during the altercation.

The situation was brought under control.

The Kanwariyas were pacified and permitted to proceed.

Victim’s Condition

Sunny Chaudhary reportedly sustained serious injuries in the assault. Some local accounts claim he is in critical condition, though official medical updates have not been publicly detailed.

The incident has triggered debate over crowd management during religious pilgrimages, safety protocols at fuel stations, and alleged police response. No further legal action has been confirmed so far.

#Bijnor #UttarPradesh #KanwarYatra #UPPolice #BreakingNews #BijnorNews

articles.title: Govandi Daylight Murder: 19-Year-Old Shot Dead in Alleged Love Triangle, 8 Arrested
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Mumbai (Maharashtra): The probe into the murder of 19-year-old Shifa Shaikh in Govandi has intensified, with the Shivaji Nagar Police Station arresting eight persons in connection with the case.

body.html:
Mumbai (Maharashtra): The probe into the murder of 19-year-old Shifa Shaikh in Govandi has intensified, with the Shivaji Nagar Police Station arresting eight persons in connection with the case.

Shifa was allegedly shot at point-blank range on February 10, 2026, in the Furqania Masjid area of Shivaji Nagar. According to police, she had stepped out around 10:30 am to buy breakfast while her family was asleep. Her father was later informed that she had been shot.

She was rushed to Noor Hospital and later shifted to Shatabdi Hospital, where doctors declared her dead.

Alleged Love Triangle

Mumbai Police said the murder appears to have stemmed from a love triangle. Rizwan Shamsuddin Shaikh (23), who allegedly has a criminal record, had befriended Shifa around eight months ago despite being in a seven-year relationship with the prime accused, Tabassum Shaikh (25).

When Tabassum allegedly came to know about the relationship, she confronted Shifa. Shifa’s family then reportedly sent her to their hometown in Uttar Pradesh for a few weeks. She had returned to Mumbai about a month before the incident.

On the day of the murder, Tabassum and her brother Sajid Shaikh (23) allegedly intercepted Shifa and took her to Rizwan’s residence in Baiganwadi, where Rizwan and his friend Kalam Chowdhury (19) were present.

During an argument, Tabassum allegedly fired a single shot from a country-made pistol at close range. The bullet struck Shifa in the upper face and lodged in her head, police said.

Arrests and Seizures

Initially, Tabassum, Sajid, Rizwan and Kalam were arrested and produced before the Kurla Magistrate Court, which remanded them to police custody till February 18.

Subsequently, four more persons — Harish Singh alias Jinda, Sadik Ansari, Akshay Kumar and Nazre Alam — were arrested for allegedly helping dispose of the body and weapons.

Police seized three country-made pistols, two magazines and four live cartridges. One more suspect remains absconding.

The accused have been booked under Section 103 (murder) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita and relevant provisions of the Indian Arms Act, 1959. Investigation into the alleged conspiracy and prior stalking is ongoing.

#Mumbai #Govandi #ShivajiNagar #CrimeNews #LoveTriangle #MurderCase #BNS #MumbaiPolice #BreakingNews

articles.title: Noida: Man and Woman Found Dead with Gunshot Wounds in Locked Car at Sector 107.
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Noida (Uttar Pradesh): A 32-year-old man and a 26-year-old woman were found dead with gunshot wounds inside a locked car in Sector 107 on February 14, 2026.

body.html:
Noida (Uttar Pradesh): A 32-year-old man and a 26-year-old woman were found dead with gunshot wounds inside a locked car in Sector 107 on February 14, 2026. Police are prima facie treating the case as a suspected murder-suicide, while continuing to examine all angles following allegations from the man’s family.

Discovery and Scene
The bodies were discovered inside a Tata Altroz parked near pillar number 84 on Dadri Road. According to police, the vehicle was locked from the inside.

The deceased have been identified as:
● Sumit (32), a resident of Trilokpuri, Delhi
● Rekha (26), a resident of Sector 101, Noida

A pistol was recovered from Sumit’s right hand, and cartridges were found inside the vehicle.

Yamuna Prasad, Deputy Commissioner of Police, said officers received information about a suspiciously parked car near Dadri Road.

“On inspection, a boy and a girl were found inside the car with gunshot injuries to their heads. A pistol was recovered from the boy’s hand and the car was locked from inside. Prima facie, it appears to be a case of suicide,” he stated.

The bodies have been sent for post-mortem examination, and forensic teams have examined the scene to determine the sequence of events.

WhatsApp Message and Relationship History

Investigators found a WhatsApp message on Sumit’s phone sent shortly before the incident. In the message, he allegedly wrote that he was ending his life because Rekha had decided to marry someone else, despite what he described as a 15-year relationship and a promise of marriage.

The message has become central to the investigation.

Family Allegations

Sumit’s family has disputed the initial s***de theory, alleging that the couple may have been murdered and were “victims of casteism.”

A cousin claimed that the two belonged to different castes and that Rekha’s family had opposed the relationship. The family also alleged that threats had been received in the past, including calls from international numbers warning of police action.

They described the location where the car was found — reportedly a few hundred metres from Rekha’s village in Salarpur — as suspicious. The family further claimed that Sumit had recently purchased a flat for Rekha and that both families were aware of the long-standing relationship.

Conversely, Rekha’s family had previously filed a harassment complaint against Sumit.

Missing Complaints and Ongoing Probe
Before the bodies were discovered:
● Sumit’s family had lodged a missing person report at the Trilokpuri police station in Delhi.
● Rekha’s family filed a missing complaint at Sector 58 police station in Noida.

Police have stated that all claims, including allegations of caste-based threats, are being investigated. Officials emphasized that while the locked vehicle and weapon recovery suggest a possible murder-suicide, no theory has been conclusively established.

Further legal proceedings are underway pending forensic and post-mortem reports.

articles.title: Shocking Incident in Vrindavan: Retired Army Officer Attacked Near Jugal Ghat.
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Vrindavan (Uttar Pradesh): A sevayat (temple attendant) of the Shri Banke Bihari Temple has been arrested after allegedly assaulting a retired Army captain with a stick, fracturing his head during a dispute near the temple premises.

body.html:
Vrindavan (Uttar Pradesh): A sevayat (temple attendant) of the Shri Banke Bihari Temple has been arrested after allegedly assaulting a retired Army captain with a stick, fracturing his head during a dispute near the temple premises.

Incident Details

The incident occurred on Radha Vallabh Mandir Road near Jugal Ghat, close to the Radhavallabh Temple. Retired Army Captain Kushendra Yadav, a resident of Ghazipur, Uttar Pradesh, had come to Vrindavan with his family for darshan.

After visiting the temple, he reportedly noticed a heated altercation between two groups on the road leading toward Jugal Ghat. Attempting to intervene and calm the situation, Captain Yadav was allegedly attacked by one of the individuals involved in the dispute.

Eyewitnesses claim that Manoj Goswami, identified as a sevayat of the Shri Banke Bihari Temple, struck the retired officer multiple times with a stick. The attack resulted in a severe head injury, with the victim sustaining a fracture and collapsing on the road in a bloodied condition.

Police Action

Local police arrived promptly after receiving information about the commotion. The injured devotee was rushed to a nearby hospital for treatment.

The station in-charge of Vrindavan stated that, based on the victim’s complaint, an FIR has been registered against Manoj Goswami under relevant sections of law. The accused has been taken into custody, and further investigation is underway.

Public Reaction

A video of the incident has reportedly gone viral on social media, showing the assault and triggering public outrage. The incident has once again raised concerns about crowd management, conduct of temple functionaries, and law enforcement response in the temple town.

Authorities have stated that the matter is being investigated thoroughly.

#Vrindavan #BankeBihariTemple #MathuraNews #UPPolice #BreakingNews #VrindavanNews

articles.title: Container Rack Falls Off Lorry, Bengaluru Techie Killed in Chittoor Road Horror
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Chittoor (Andhra Pradesh): A 32-year-old software engineer was killed after a massive container rack from a moving lorry crashed onto his car in Iruvaram area of Chittoor town on Friday. The deceased has been identified as D.

body.html:
Chittoor (Andhra Pradesh): A 32-year-old software engineer was killed after a massive container rack from a moving lorry crashed onto his car in Iruvaram area of Chittoor town on Friday.

The deceased has been identified as D. Anudeepak, a resident of Ramapuram village in Gudipala mandal of Chittoor district. He was travelling in his car when the accident occurred.

According to Chittoor Traffic Police Station inspector G Nithya Babu, the container lorry driver swerved abruptly while attempting to avoid a biker approaching from the Yadamarri side. In the process, the lorry mounted the road divider, causing the container rack to dislodge and topple onto a car coming from the opposite direction.

The heavy structure crushed the vehicle, killing Anudeepak on the spot. Police said that although there were no major external injuries, severe internal damage to vital organs, including the lungs and heart, led to his instantaneous death. He was employed as a software engineer at an IT firm in Bengaluru.

Authorities dismissed rumours circulating on social media that claimed six fatalities, clarifying that only one person died in the crash.

Anudeepak’s body has been shifted to Chittoor Government Hospital for post-mortem examination.

The lorry driver has been taken into custody and the vehicle seized. The biker involved sustained minor injuries and is undergoing treatment at the government hospital.

Police have registered a case against both the lorry driver and the biker. Further investigation is underway.

articles.title: Valentine’s Day Showdown: Husband Catches Wife with Lover, Street Brawl on Hapur Flyover
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Hapur (Uttar Pradesh): High-voltage drama unfolded on Valentine’s Day after a husband allegedly caught his wife with her lover on the Meerut Road flyover in the City Kotwali area, triggering a fierce fight in the middle of the road.

body.html:
Hapur (Uttar Pradesh): High-voltage drama unfolded on Valentine’s Day after a husband allegedly caught his wife with her lover on the Meerut Road flyover in the City Kotwali area, triggering a fierce fight in the middle of the road.

According to police, the couple, residents of the City Kotwali locality, have two children. The husband reportedly suspected his wife of having an affair. On Saturday, when she left home, he followed her on his motorcycle. On reaching the Meerut Road flyover, he allegedly found her in a compromising situation with a young man.

The husband immediately stopped them on the road, leading to a heated argument that soon escalated into a physical altercation. Eyewitnesses said the husband grabbed the lover by the collar, while the latter retaliated. At one point, the husband was seen holding the man by the throat. The wife intervened repeatedly, attempting to separate the two and was also heard issuing warnings during the scuffle.

The incident caused a traffic disruption as a large crowd gathered and some bystanders recorded videos of the clash.

On receiving information, police from City Kotwali Police Station Hapur reached the spot and took all three into custody. After questioning, both men were issued a challan for disturbing public peace.

Kotwali in-charge Vinod Pandey said the matter is under investigation.

articles.title: Instagram Affair Ends in ‘Box Murder’: Woman’s Body Found in Septic Tank, Live-in Partner Arrested
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Bhopal (Madhya Pradesh): In a sensational case from the Nishatpura area, police have solved the murder of a woman whose decomposed body was found stuffed inside an iron trunk and dumped in a septic tank near Kamla Nagar.

body.html:
Bhopal (Madhya Pradesh): In a sensational case from the Nishatpura area, police have solved the murder of a woman whose decomposed body was found stuffed inside an iron trunk and dumped in a septic tank near Kamla Nagar.

The deceased has been identified as Ashrafi alias Siya (also referred to as Misbah), aged between 22 and 33 years as per varying records, a native of Gondia district in Maharashtra. Police said the case was cracked within 24 hours of the body’s recovery.

The body was discovered on Thursday afternoon after children playing on a vacant plot near Housing Board Colony complained of a foul smell. Around 3:30 pm, police were alerted about a suspicious trunk floating in a drain/septic tank. Upon opening it, officers found a severely decomposed woman’s body. Identification was established through a tattoo on her hand bearing the name “Deep” and the year 1992, along with verification of missing person records.

According to police, Siya had come to Bhopal around five years ago and had met the main accused, Sameer Khan, through Instagram about a year ago. The two developed a relationship, and in October 2025 she began living with him in Kamla Nagar. Sameer was already married and had children. Police said he had initially introduced Siya to family members as a “friend”.

Investigations revealed that tensions escalated after Siya allegedly demanded marriage or ₹5 lakh to separate. Frequent disputes reportedly led Sameer’s wife to temporarily leave for her parental home in Jabalpur.

On the night of February 7–8, 2026, following a heated argument, Sameer allegedly strangled Siya to death. Her body was kept inside the house for a day before being sealed in an iron trunk and thrown into a septic tank located about 200 metres from the accused’s residence.

Police have arrested Sameer Khan along with three of his family members — his mother Shehnaz Bi, sister Sayma, and brother Sahil — for their alleged involvement in concealing the crime. Authorities are continuing further investigation to establish the full sequence of events and roles of each accused.

The incident has sent shockwaves across the Nishatpura locality, highlighting a tragic end to what began as a social media relationship.

articles.title: “Naagin Drama” in Auraiya district: Missing Woman Reappears After Marrying Lover
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A sensational case from Uttar Pradesh’s Auraiya district, where a 25-year-old woman allegedly “turned into an Icchadhari Naagin”, has taken a dramatic turn after she resurfaced and announced her marriage to her long-time partner.

body.html:
A sensational case from Uttar Pradesh’s Auraiya district, where a 25-year-old woman allegedly “turned into an Icchadhari Naagin”, has taken a dramatic turn after she resurfaced and announced her marriage to her long-time partner.

On 10 February 2026, Reena, the youngest among five sisters, went missing from her home after her family had reportedly fixed her marriage elsewhere.

The next morning, family members found a five-foot-long snake’s shed skin (kenchuli), along with bangles, a bindi and jewellery, placed on her bed. Panic spread across the village, with rumours that she had transformed into a serpent woman (naagin).

An FIR was lodged, and police began tracing her location.

During investigation, police found that Reena had been in a relationship for the past four years with Satnam, a resident of the same village. According to sources, Reena had repeatedly resisted attempts by her father to arrange her marriage. She allegedly told her family vivid stories about snakes visiting her at night and claimed she was an “Icchadhari Naagin” whose male serpent lived with her.

Police later traced her to an Arya Samaj temple in Kanpur, where she married Satnam after performing traditional rituals, including the seven pheras. The couple also reportedly registered their marriage legally.

A day after her disappearance triggered chaos, Reena appeared in an Instagram video with Satnam standing behind her, stating that she had married of her own free will and asking authorities not to harass her in-laws.

When questioned about the snake slough, she claimed that a snake used to sleep beside her at night and that one of the shed skins belonged to it. Police have recorded her statement and are expected to produce her before a magistrate for formal recording under legal procedure.

An old dance video of Reena, reportedly shot in rural fields to a song themed around serpent couples, has now gone viral on social media, further amplifying the “naagin drama” narrative.

Officials maintain that the case is linked to a love affair and her opposition to an arranged marriage. With Reena having returned and given her statement, further action will depend on court proceedings.
